source.rights: 项目原创，AI辅助编写；模拟场景与数据
source.method: 从本次新原创阅读派生的规则、原句词与不同情境输出；不改名复用旧源。

questions.prompt: This bag is ______ than that one.
questions.explanation: 比较两个包，用比较级 more expensive。
questions.evidence: The door cost more than a normal door, but it was the most useful change.

questions.prompt: ______ of the students passed the exam.
questions.explanation: 表示“大多数学生”，用 Most of the students。
questions.evidence: But after two weeks, most people agreed it was a good idea.

questions.prompt: The books are on the table. Please put ______ in the box.
questions.explanation: 指代前面的 books（复数），作宾语用 them。
questions.evidence: They also added more chairs near the window.

questions.prompt: She ______ a new phone last week.
questions.explanation: last week 表示过去，用过去式 bought。
questions.evidence: The library installed a new automatic door.

questions.prompt: There ______ some milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: milk 是不可数名词，there be 结构用 is。
questions.evidence: There are many stairs, and there is no lift.

questions.prompt: I have ______ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: friends 是可数名词复数，用 many 修饰。
questions.evidence: Many older visitors and parents with small children had trouble.

questions.explanation: honest 以元音音素开头，用 an。这里引入一个非特定的诚实男孩，所以用不定冠词 an。
questions.evidence: The main door was heavy and hard to open.

questions.explanation: news 是不可数名词，谓语用单数 is。
questions.evidence: The staff said, "Good signs help everyone, not only people who cannot see well."

title: Inclusive by Design: A Library's Small Changes · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课重点是比较结构（如 more...than, the most...）、数量表达（如 many, some, most）、指代（如 it, they, this）以及冠词和主谓一致。比较结构用于比较两个事物；数量表达说明多少；指代要明确所指对象；冠词a/an/the要正确使用；主谓一致要求主语和谓语在数上一致。

The door cost more than a normal door, but it was the most useful change.
